themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact within research environments.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, review, and understand code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from discovery to analysis.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to automate or enhance the process of testing the usability of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, aiding in information digestion.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Deals with the creation and use of artificial user personas or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI influences job roles, creation, displacement, and the skills needed in the modern workforce.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers the study of conversational AI, including their behavior, biases, psychological impact, and effectiveness in user interactions.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Investigates AI's application in the design process, including generative design, interface design, and AI's influence on design thinking.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in gathering, analyzing, and leveraging customer data to understand behavior and inform business decisions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
